title: TRUNK-6707: Implement full caching for Global Properties
body:
<!--- Add a pull request title above in this format -->
<!--- real example: 'TRUNK-5111: Replace use of deprecated isVoided' -->
<!--- 'TRUNK-JiraIssueNumber: JiraIssueTitle' -->
## Description of what I changed
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->
<!--- It can simply be your commit message, which you must have -->

Global properties are read constantly through OpenMRS and rarely change over the course of an application execution. This PR adds aggressive, layered caching for Global Properties to reduce the number of database calls and, ultimately, speed up getting global properties. Global properties are now backed by our in-memory distributed cache. Writes to global properties will evict the value. The cache holds entries for no more than 15 minutes in case any maintenance is performed by raw SQL. As a result, implementers should expect that GP updates done outside of OpenMRS may take up to 1 hour to become effective. In most cases, GP updates will be effective immediately, but if a thread reads the cache while the write / evict is in progress, it may get a stale value. This should generally be a window of milliseconds.

This also solves TRUNK-6771 because ConfigUtil no longer maintains its own cache.
